Aloo Capsicum Recipe
By: NIDA FAREED
Published: Monday, July 4, 2011 - 2:28pm

Ingredients




Ingredients:
4 • Capsicums
2 • Potatoes
1 • Large chopped onion
1 • Large chopped tomato
1/2 teaspoon • Turmeric powder
1/2 teaspoon • Red chilli powder
1 teaspoon • Ground coriander
2 tablespoons • Oil
• Salt to taste
• Coriander leaves

Preparation

1 How to make Aloo Capsicum: 2 Wash capsicum and potatoes and cut into pieces. 3 Heat the oil and fry chopped onion till it turns brown. 4 Add capsicum and potato and fry it for few minutes. 5 Add chopped tomato, turmeric powder,red chili powder,ground coriander and salt. 6 Mix it well and cook it till it turns tender. 7 Garnish it with fresh coriander leaves. 8 Serve hot with rotis.
